--- revoke_execute_on_all_table_functions_in_default_schema.sql
REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL TABLE FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE consumer

--- AST
&ast.Revoke{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnAllFunctionsInSchema{
    Execute: 7,
    Table:   22,
    Default: 48,
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 66,
      NameEnd: 74,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL TABLE FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT FROM ROLE consumer
